feeds.title: NextBillion » Impact Investing
feeds.description: NextBillion is an open forum for discussion of social enterprise, poverty alleviation, and business development in emerging markets and beyond. Its goal is to stimulate discussion, raise awareness, and provide a platform for sharing ideas that improve the lives of the poor and reshape entire economies.

feeds.title: Pioneers Post
feeds.description: Through our stories, videos, podcasts, events, and partnerships and as a social enterprise ourselves we are committed to supporting, sharing, scrutinizing and celebrating the impact economy at every level, from entrepreneur to investor, to market builder and asset manager, across sectors and in every continent around the globe.

feeds.title: Social Good Stuff
feeds.description: Social Good Stuff is full of Ideas, Resources, and Inspiration for Creating Positive Societal Impact. It aims to create the potential of individuals, technology, and collaboration to create a positive societal impact. The quality or state of being that is positive, optimistic, or constructive.

feeds.title: Acumen Blog
feeds.description: Acumen, a global nonprofit changing the way the world tackles poverty by investing in sustainable businesses, leaders, and ideas. Our vision is a world based on dignity, where every human being has the same opportunity. Rather than giving philanthropy away, we invest it in companies and change-makers.

feeds.title: Beautiful Enterprise
feeds.description: Tim Thorlby, the Director of Beautiful Enterprise publishes blogs on faith, enterprise, and purpose here. He encourages thought, discussion, and change for a purpose-driven marketplace that can be a powerful force for positive social change. He provides research and consultancy support to public services, charities, and enterprises.

feeds.title: Pro Bono Australia
feeds.description: Pro Bono News is a news outlet for Australia's social economy. We cover all sectors under the umbrella of the purpose economy, from charities and not for profits, to impact investing, philanthropy, volunteering, corporate social responsibility, and social enterprise.

feeds.title: B The Change
feeds.description: B the Change is a collaboration of B Lab, the community of Certified B Corps, and to inform and inspire people who have a passion for using business as a force for good in the world. We believe our work towards an inclusive and equitable economic system has never been more important. In the community, we will find resilience.

feeds.title: Echoing Green | Funding Social Entrepreneurship & Innovation
feeds.description: Echoing Green, a non-profit organization works at the intersection of social justice and social innovation, connecting our expertise and global networks to emerging leaders creating long-lasting social change. Each of us approaches our work with passion and a dedication to supporting the change our Fellows are making in the world. We value social justice, innovation, inclusivity, and community.

feeds.title: Social Enterprise Development in the Baltic Sea Region
feeds.description: The Network's mission is to promote social entrepreneurship by developing integrated learning and sharing platform in the Nordic-Baltic area. Let's make social innovation and collaboration happen, together.

feeds.title: School for Social Entrepreneurs
feeds.description: Welcome to our social enterprise blog. SSE delivers practical courses that empower, upskill, and inspire social entrepreneurs; people with business ideas that benefit society. Here you'll find news, views, and updates from the School for Social Entrepreneurs.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Social enterprises
feeds.description: The Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice is available for everyone, funded by readers. Get the latest social enterprise news, opinion, analysis, and reviews from the Guardian.

feeds.title: FYA | Welcome home
feeds.description: FYA is a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting young Australians. We aim to develop the skills, networks, and ideas of young Australians so they can create a better future. Backing the next generation of young people who are going to rethink the world. Subscribe to FYA to get the latest news and updates for the dreamers, the doers, the thinkers, the makers, and the innovators.

feeds.title: Causeartist | Social Impact Lifestyle Platform
feeds.description: Causeartist is a global community and social enterprise platform, which covers brands, startups, and social entrepreneurs impacting the world through social enterprise. It features original interviews, lists, and spotlights with founders and CEOs from some of the most exciting Social Enterprises impacting the world. It is there to help you discover what's new and trending in the world of Social Enterprise and Social Impact.

feeds.title: Devex | News
feeds.description: Devex is the media platform for the global development community. As a social enterprise, we connect and inform one million+ development, health, humanitarian, and sustainability professionals through news, business intelligence, and funding & career opportunities so you can do more good for more people

feeds.title: Social Enterprise Alliance | Empowering Social Businesses for Good
feeds.description: Social Enterprise Alliance is the national membership organization and key catalyst for the rapidly growing social enterprise movement in the United States. We provide social enterprises with the resources they need to succeed, support, and grow social entrepreneurship on a national scale and serve as a voice for a more sustainable social impact. Join the movement.

feeds.title: Social Change Central Blog
feeds.description: Get resources, events, and articles for businesses that are changing the world for the better on the Social Change Central blog. SCC connects, encourages, and supports social enterprises and aspiring entrepreneurs. The mission is to ensure that Australia's social entrepreneurs and social enterprises get access to the critical support they need to convert their passion and ideas for social good into real social impact.

feeds.title: Social Enterprise UK Blog
feeds.description: Together with our members we are the voice for social enterprise. We do research, provide information and tools, share knowledge, build networks, raise awareness and campaign to create a business environment where social enterprises can thrive.
